cohort: Oct15 UTC publication-day, 302 actual fills / 69 traded settled windows, excluding inherited +.01 and zero-share settlement

definitions.pnl: Actual winning-side expiry payout minus observed cost and actual fee; additive attribution, not separately executable trading strategies.
definitions.inventory_role: Running observed venue-timestamp fill quantities, starting flat for fully reconciled day-filled window. Toward_equal_inventory quantity capped at prefill opposite-minus-own; any excess separate. Ties unknown. Not controller decision-time confirmed inventory or admission guard classification; no pending liabilities considered.
definitions.first_side_relation: Every actual fill on same side as earliest actual fill versus opposite; opposite is not necessarily inventory balancing.
definitions.pair_split: Final side-average cost including fees allocated to min(up,down) pairs; remaining cost and payout attributed to residual. Mirrors settlement arithmetic; not chronological pair matching.
definitions.payout_clock: Final gross payout includes early paired-credit plus residual expiry; attribution does not identify actual cash credit timing and must not credit paired proceeds twice.
definitions.partial_roles: Actual fee allocated pro rata to quantities when one fill crosses equality; fill_count can overlap roles and must not be summed as distinct fills.

limits: No inference of no-lock/no-maker policy returns; removing orders changes future inventory, caps, decisions and risk.
Mixed earlier source versions, one-day executed-fill development cohort; no full stream/book completeness or causality.
No threshold tuning, source/cap/stop/production changes, or sealed TEST reads.
